body: Dave identified Spas in Jamaica as case study #2 and an urgent external-business pilot. Spas is already using NouGen tools to help close website deals even though Dave has not billed him yet. Fold him into the active MCP scale destiny as the first real external-user tenant after Dave. Design the thinnest secure onboarding path: Google auth -> tenant resolution -> Spas-only vault/shards/relays/tracker/provider budget, with zero access to Dave's data or credentials. Instrument onboarding friction, first useful task, business/deal outcomes, inference usage, reliability, and support burden. Use this pilot to expose hardcoded Dave assumptions and shape hosted MCP pricing/metering, while keeping a local/free lane where feasible. Done when the fleet returns a concrete Case Study 2 onboarding checklist, isolation test plan, telemetry schema, and recommended first paid/free boundary.
